__inputs.name: DS_INFLUXDB
__inputs.label: House InfluxDB (Flux)
__inputs.description: InfluxDB v2 datasource using the Flux query language, with a token that can read the house and house_1h buckets

title: House metrics
description: Device state and commands recorded by metricsd. Short ranges read the raw 'house' bucket; ranges reaching back more than 28 days read the hourly 'house_1h' rollup.

targets.query:
import "experimental"
bucketName = if v.timeRangeStart < experimental.subDuration(d: 28d, from: now()) then "house_1h" else "house"
window = if bucketName == "house_1h" and int(v: v.windowPeriod) < int(v: 1h) then 1h else v.windowPeriod

from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "state" and r.trait == "air_properties" and r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => bucketName == "house" or r.agg == "mean")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_name =~ /^${device:regex}$/)
  |> toFloat()
  |> group(columns: ["device_name"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "device_name"])

panels.title: Commands by origin
panels.description: Commands bridges processed, counted per window. Empty origin means the caller didn't set one.

targets.query:
import "experimental"
bucketName = if v.timeRangeStart < experimental.subDuration(d: 28d, from: now()) then "house_1h" else "house"
window = if int(v: v.windowPeriod) < int(v: 1h) then 1h else v.windowPeriod

from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "command" and r._field == "outcome")
  |> group(columns: ["origin"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: window, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "origin"])

panels.title: Recent commands
panels.description: Newest 50 commands in the selected range. outcome is a gRPC status code (0 = OK).

targets.query:
import "experimental"
bucketName = if v.timeRangeStart < experimental.subDuration(d: 28d, from: now()) then "house_1h" else "house"

from(bucket: bucketName)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "command")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 50)
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "_measurement", "command_id", "resulting_version"])
